review_scope: Fresh source-only review of the admin SEO acceptance runner and preparation report against seo-admin-source-peer.json. No runtime, browser, build, test, or release work was performed; no source was edited.
runtime_verdict: PENDING: this lane did not execute a browser, runner, build, or release and attests no T07/T09 runtime pass.

addressed_findings.finding: T09 compared the SEO Headings group with h1 presence, although that group represents heading elements generally.
addressed_findings.evidence: The public-page oracle now checks h1 through h6, and the preparation oracle describes heading-group presence rather than h1 presence. This remains a presence-only check; it does not establish heading text, levels, counts, or full SEO fidelity.

addressed_findings.finding: T07 could accept an unrelated open menu elsewhere in the document.
addressed_findings.evidence: The runner requires one Copy audit trigger in the selected SEO pane, resolves its aria-controls target, and accepts choices only when that controlled popup and trigger both report open state. It opens the menu through the trigger and does not activate an option.

addressed_findings.finding: An early harness failure could occur before the receipt directory existed.
addressed_findings.evidence: The outer catch records a fixed failure stage, then mkdir creates test-results recursively before the sanitized JSON receipt is written. Receipt writing itself remains dependent on filesystem availability.

evidence: Admin authentication remains through the real aimatrx.com login form, checks the configured admin email, fills the password from the aidream .env only at form submission, and verifies the extension Settings UI shows that email, admin role, and Sign out control.

The organization is selected through the Settings picker and checked in both the displayed control and chrome.storage.local. No response/auth state is injected, and raw exceptions and credential values are not placed in the receipt.

SEO assertions read two public pages and compare their DOM titles and heading presence against the selected linked SEO pane. The menu only checks option availability. The runner does not select a menu option, write clipboard content, save/delete an audit, invoke recommendations, stage Chat/Pilot work, or exercise a provider request.
The report remains unverified until the native harness callback completes and records only fixed stage names and bounded booleans.
limits: This confirms source intent only. It does not establish that sign-in, organization selection, accessibility links, popup state, or page observations work in the native panel.
The positive admin JSON menu check does not prove a non-admin exclusion gate.
Clipboard contents, saved audits/history, recommendations, member-role behavior, and the remaining SEO details are not covered.

coverage: If the root-owned guarded runtime run passes, count only partial T07 admin menu availability and T09 two-page title/heading-group presence. Keep other SEO targets and runtime behavior open until separately exercised.
